description: Replay on a fresh SQLite database. client_account is a logical name: C uses it directly; Java/Go/.NET map it to specus_client_account. C applies its explicit implementationSetupOverrides because its account schema has no password_hash and calls the rate column connection_limit_per_minute, and its Peer device has no created_at; logical rows and all checks are unchanged. Run deletion of clientId through each available plain/audited management deletion path, once successfully and once with a late BEFORE DELETE trigger that aborts the account delete. Every check must equal deleted after commit or retained after rollback. Do not delete rows directly to emulate the operation.
